concept: 如何防范安娜斯塔西亚杀
question_cn: 为避免被安娜斯塔西亚杀，以下哪种做法最有效？
question_en: What is the most effective way to avoid Anastasia's mate?

options.text_cn: 把王躲在兵后面，不要走出来
options.text_en: Keep the king behind the pawns and never move it out

options.text_cn: 尽量保持王有向中心逃脱的路线，避免王被困在边线
options.text_en: Keep an escape route toward the center and avoid trapping the king on the edge

options.text_cn: 换掉对方的车，车是完成将死的关键棋子
options.text_en: Trade off the opponent's rook, the key piece in the mating pattern

options.text_cn: 多走兵，兵可以挡住对方马的跳入
options.text_en: Advance more pawns to stop the opponent's knight from jumping in

explanation_cn: 防范安娜斯塔西亚杀的核心是不让王被困在边线。保持王有向中心逃脱的路线，避免让对方马占据封锁内侧的关键格子。换掉对方的马也是有效手段，因为马是封锁逃格的关键。
explanation_en: The key is to keep the king from becoming trapped on the edge. Preserve an escape route toward the center and prevent the enemy knight from occupying the key inward-blocking square. Trading off that knight can also remove a crucial part of the mating net.
